name: Merge Sort
description:
Implement Merge Sort to sort an integer slice in ascending order.

Merge Sort is a classic divide-and-conquer algorithm. It divides the input slice into two halves, recursively sorts them, and then merges the two sorted halves.

complexity.time: O(N log N) guaranteed in all cases

hints: Base case: if len(arr) <= 1, it is already sorted, return arr.
Divide: find mid := len(arr)/2. Recursively sort the left half (arr[:mid]) and right half (arr[mid:]).
Conquer / Merge: merge two sorted slices into a single sorted slice by comparing front elements with two pointers i and j.
